text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary for model route `embed-route` -> model v2.3-quant2 in eu-west-1. Canary=20% (3 hosts). Monitoring: embed_medium synthetic probe. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/post-deploy-smoke. :rocket:
Priya (oncall): mid-canary flagging a big p95 jump on embed_medium around 4m in. p50 steady ~140ms, p95 jumped to ~920ms. Also seeing ~2.5% 429s from probe agent (rate-limited?) — but traffic not that high. :thinking_face:
Omar: Checking host logs now. I'm seeing worker stalls and repeated `kernel: stall on cpu` messages on 2 of 3 canary hosts. Noticed long memcpy spikes in the per-request trace, time spent in quantized pack/unpack kernels.
Hana (eng-ml): Quant2 changed the packing stride for KV tiles to optimize memory; could cause slower kernel path for mid-length sequences. Haven't seen this in perf tests for seq<=64, but if probes use 128 we're in a different code path.
Sam (releases): Proposal: pause rollout and pin eu-west-1 to v2.2.1-stable. Drain canary hosts. Better to be conservative.
deploy-bot: Auto-check triggered: error_rate > threshold (1%) and p95 > 500ms. Canary paused and frozen at 20% traffic. :warning:
Priya (oncall): Can someone run a simple reproducible curl against the canary host to capture headers + timing? Example:```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST https://eu-west1-canary.api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"lorem ipsum"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code} TIME:%{time_total}\n"
```
Sample results I got: `HTTP:200 TIME:0.39` from host A, `HTTP:429 TIME:0.82` from host B, `HTTP:200 TIME:5.12` from host C (request stuck then returned).
Omar: I'm pulling perf maps and flamegraphs now. Also enabling `--trace-kernel` on a repro host. Reproducer command I'll run: `./run_repro --model v2.3-quant2 --seqlen 128 --warmup 10 --requests 200 --debug-kv`
Hana (eng-ml): If you can reproduce, try `--kv-size 256` as well. I suspect the quant packing triggers a fallback GEMM with high memcpy for those dimensions.
Sam (releases): I'm going to pin the region and drain canary. Command: ```bash
redwoodctl routes set embed-route --region eu-west-1 --model v2.2.1-stable --reason "post-canary p95 & 429 spike" --owner sam@redwood.com
```
Sam (releases): Executed pin. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Route update recorded: embed-route pinned to v2.2.1-stable in eu-west-1 by Sam. Canary hosts removed from serving pool. Event logged: route.pin.user.
Priya (oncall): Confirmed: all traffic in eu-west-1 now on v2.2.1. Canary pool size 0. Starting trace collection from affected hosts.
Omar: Uploaded perf artifacts and flamegraphs to gs://redwood-traces/1799999999/ — files: perf-host3.svg, flame-host3.svg, perf-host2.pb. Added brief notes about observed memcpy hotspots and kernel stall timestamps.
Hana (eng-ml): Opening follow-up ticket to block EU rollout until we validate kernel changes and add mid-length synth probe (seq 64-256). Ticket: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-5607 Assigned to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
Sam (releases): Also adding a short update to release notes marking v2.3-quant2 EU rollout paused and calling out potential perf regression for mid-length embeds. Will notify early-access customers in EU.
deploy-bot: Incident created from route pin: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1799999999. Runbook suggestion: "smoke-test-kernel-fallout".
Priya (oncall): Next steps for eng-runtime/eng-ml: 1) Reproduce with seqlen 128+ and kv-size variants 2) Instrument quant kernels with microtimers 3) Run canary with extra debug flags in staging before reattempting EU rollout.
Omar: On it. I'll attach repro logs and perf diff to INC-5607. If we confirm packing path regression, we'll coordinate a hotfix rollback of the kernel layer or revert model variant.
Hana (eng-ml): If a kernel fix is needed we'll also run an A/B canary with a binary that flips packing heuristics. Suggest a narrow 5% canary and targeted synth probes.
Sam (releases): Thanks team. Thread decision: pin maintained, canary drained, ticket & incident created, traces uploaded. Marking rollout paused for EU.
Priya (oncall): I'll continue monitoring synth and infra dashboards and will update INC-5607 if anything else appears. :thumbsup:
